request.prompt:
Return ONE JSON object, no markdown, executable code or explanation.
You control the entire 8-slide, 16:9 deck. Coordinates are inches on a 13.333333 x 7.5 canvas.
Native editable PowerPoint objects are generated from this scene. Use at most 28 elements/slide.
Schema: {"theme":{"background":"FFFFFF","ink":"172B4D","accent":"007F86","font":"Arial"},
"slides":[{"background":"FFFFFF","elements":[...]}]}. Theme and slide background are optional.
Colors are six hex digits without #. Use only installed fonts Arial, Georgia or Calibri.
Each element has type plus these fields (no other element types):
text: x,y,w,h,text,size (points),color,bold (bool),align (left/center/right). Optional fields use size=18, theme ink.
rect: x,y,w,h,fill; optional line (color),radius (bool). Rectangles contain no text; add a text object.
line: x,y,x2,y2,color,width (points). Lines are native connectors.
chart: x,y,w,h,kind (bar/column/line),categories (strings),series ([{"name":"...","values":[numbers]}]),
  optional colors (one hex per series),size (axis/data text points, default 14),legend (bool),labels (bool).
  Charts have native data/workbooks, start value axis at zero, and omit an automatic title. Add title and units with text.
table: x,y,w,h,rows (rectangular array of strings), optional size (default 14),header_fill,header_color,fill,color.
  First row is the header. All rows have equal height. Cells wrap; leave enough space.
Numbers must be finite. Put every object inside the canvas. Text wraps with a small fixed margin.
No automatic content repair, layout optimization, font shrinking or factual correction occurs.
Keep all facts accurate. Aim for a polished deck: hierarchy, alignment, contrast, restrained color,
legible labels and purposeful charts/diagrams. Vary layouts with the story. Make the decision easy to find.
Stay below 75,000 characters of JSON. Do not add author/model/tool names. No external assets or web access.

Additional optional authoring helpers expand deterministically into the SAME native primitives:
header: title, optional subtitle. Measures the installed font and inserts safe line breaks. Title uses
  24-27pt in a two-line band at (0.55,0.22,12.2,0.91); single-line subtitle uses 10-12pt at y=1.18.
  Accent rule y=1.48; put body at y>=1.7. Very long titles/subtitles fail explicitly; keep them concise.
kpi: x,y,w,h,value,label, optional color. Places a large value over its smaller label, with a colored rule.
flow: x,y,w,h,labels (2-5 short strings), optional fill,color. Evenly spaces editable boxes and connectors.
columns: x,y,w,h,items ([{"title":"...","body":"..."}]), optional fill,color. Two to four equal columns,
  each with a 19pt title and 16pt body. Leave room for text. These helpers do not choose your narrative or content.
Theme colors and fonts are yours to choose. Helpers are optional; all primitive tools remain available.

TASK

You control the entire 8-slide, 16:9 deck. Coordinates are inches on a 13.333333 x 7.5 canvas.
Native editable PowerPoint objects are generated from this scene. Use at most 28 elements/slide.
Schema: {"theme":{"background":"FFFFFF","ink":"172B4D","accent":"007F86","font":"Arial"},
"slides":[{"background":"FFFFFF","elements":[...]}]}. Theme and slide background are optional.
Colors are six hex digits without #. Use only installed fonts Arial, Georgia or Calibri.
Each element has type plus these fields (no other element types):
text: x,y,w,h,text,size (points),color,bold (bool),align (left/center/right). Optional fields use size=18, theme ink.
rect: x,y,w,h,fill; optional line (color),radius (bool). Rectangles contain no text; add a text object.
line: x,y,x2,y2,color,width (points). Lines are native connectors.
chart: x,y,w,h,kind (bar/column/line),categories (strings),series ([{"name":"...","values":[numbers]}]),
  optional colors (one hex per series),size (axis/data text points, default 14),legend (bool),labels (bool).
  Charts have native data/workbooks, start value axis at zero, and omit an automatic title. Add title and units with text.
table: x,y,w,h,rows (rectangular array of strings), optional size (default 14),header_fill,header_color,fill,color.
  First row is the header. All rows have equal height. Cells wrap; leave enough space.
Numbers must be finite. Put every object inside the canvas. Text wraps with a small fixed margin.
No automatic content repair, layout optimization, font shrinking or factual correction occurs.
Keep all facts accurate. Aim for a polished deck: hierarchy, alignment, contrast, restrained color,
legible labels and purposeful charts/diagrams. Vary layouts with the story. Make the decision easy to find.
Stay below 75,000 characters of JSON. Do not add author/model/tool names. No external assets or web access.

Additional optional authoring helpers expand deterministically into the SAME native primitives:
header: title, optional subtitle. Measures the installed font and inserts safe line breaks. Title uses
  24-27pt in a two-line band at (0.55,0.22,12.2,0.91); single-line subtitle uses 10-12pt at y=1.18.
  Accent rule y=1.48; put body at y>=1.7. Very long titles/subtitles fail explicitly; keep them concise.
kpi: x,y,w,h,value,label, optional color. Places a large value over its smaller label, with a colored rule.
flow: x,y,w,h,labels (2-5 short strings), optional fill,color. Evenly spaces editable boxes and connectors.
columns: x,y,w,h,items ([{"title":"...","body":"..."}]), optional fill,color. Two to four equal columns,
  each with a 19pt title and 16pt body. Leave room for text. These helpers do not choose your narrative or content.
Theme colors and fonts are yours to choose. Helpers are optional; all primitive tools remain available.

TASK
Create exactly eight slides for a fictional decision committee. All data are synthetic. No cover-only slide. Keep each slide useful at presentation distance. Use finding titles and an intentional sequence. 1: executive recommendation, chosen investment, annual saving, payback and three-year net saving. 2: six-month actual versus target native chart with all 12 data values, total actual, total target and gap. 3: native option table showing every cell; explain the selected option's tradeoff. 4: native chart of downside/base/upside annual savings; show three paybacks and three-year net savings. 5: native five-site table showing every cell, total daily demand and capacity, and name capacity-constrained sites. 6: connected two-lane Technical/People roadmap, with Decision gate; show all activities, weeks and dependencies. 7: likelihood-by-impact risk matrix with labeled axes and risk IDs at correct coordinates, plus all mitigations. 8: funding and go/no-go decision, gate timing, every threshold, fallback HOLD if any threshold fails, and next rollout. Currency is $k; simple payback is investment / annual saving, one decimal year. Three-year net is 3*saving-investment. Site demand/capacity are daily, not the six-month totals. Downside/base/upside use 80/100/120% of selected saving. Show unchanged reference option prices even after the recommendation changes. For the initial draft recommend Balanced at the stated investment and saving. Return ONE JSON object, no markdown, executable code or explanation.
You control the entire 8-slide, 16:9 deck. Coordinates are inches on a 13.333333 x 7.5 canvas.
Native editable PowerPoint objects are generated from this scene. Use at most 28 elements/slide.
Schema: {"theme":{"background":"FFFFFF","ink":"172B4D","accent":"007F86","font":"Arial"},
"slides":[{"background":"FFFFFF","elements":[...]}]}. Theme and slide background are optional.
Colors are six hex digits without #. Use only installed fonts Arial, Georgia or Calibri.
Each element has type plus these fields (no other element types):
text: x,y,w,h,text,size (points),color,bold (bool),align (left/center/right). Optional fields use size=18, theme ink.
rect: x,y,w,h,fill; optional line (color),radius (bool). Rectangles contain no text; add a text object.
line: x,y,x2,y2,color,width (points). Lines are native connectors.
chart: x,y,w,h,kind (bar/column/line),categories (strings),series ([{"name":"...","values":[numbers]}]),
  optional colors (one hex per series),size (axis/data text points, default 14),legend (bool),labels (bool).
  Charts have native data/workbooks, start value axis at zero, and omit an automatic title. Add title and units with text.
table: x,y,w,h,rows (rectangular array of strings), optional size (default 14),header_fill,header_color,fill,color.
  First row is the header. All rows have equal height. Cells wrap; leave enough space.
Numbers must be finite. Put every object inside the canvas. Text wraps with a small fixed margin.
No automatic content repair, layout optimization, font shrinking or factual correction occurs.
Keep all facts accurate. Aim for a polished deck: hierarchy, alignment, contrast, restrained color,
legible labels and purposeful charts/diagrams. Vary layouts with the story. Make the decision easy to find.
Stay below 75,000 characters of JSON. Do not add author/model/tool names. No external assets or web access.

Additional optional authoring helpers expand deterministically into the SAME native primitives:
header: title, optional subtitle. Measures the installed font and inserts safe line breaks. Title uses
  24-27pt in a two-line band at (0.55,0.22,12.2,0.91); single-line subtitle uses 10-12pt at y=1.18.
  Accent rule y=1.48; put body at y>=1.7. Very long titles/subtitles fail explicitly; keep them concise.
kpi: x,y,w,h,value,label, optional color. Places a large value over its smaller label, with a colored rule.
flow: x,y,w,h,labels (2-5 short strings), optional fill,color. Evenly spaces editable boxes and connectors.
columns: x,y,w,h,items ([{"title":"...","body":"..."}]), optional fill,color. Two to four equal columns,
  each with a 19pt title and 16pt body. Leave room for text. These helpers do not choose your narrative or content.
Theme colors and fonts are yours to choose. Helpers are optional; all primitive tools remain available.

ORIGINAL TASK
Create exactly eight slides for a fictional decision committee. All data are synthetic. No cover-only slide. Keep each slide useful at presentation distance. Use finding titles and an intentional sequence. 1: executive recommendation, chosen investment, annual saving, payback and three-year net saving. 2: six-month actual versus target native chart with all 12 data values, total actual, total target and gap. 3: native option table showing every cell; explain the selected option's tradeoff. 4: native chart of downside/base/upside annual savings; show three paybacks and three-year net savings. 5: native five-site table showing every cell, total daily demand and capacity, and name capacity-constrained sites. 6: connected two-lane Technical/People roadmap, with Decision gate; show all activities, weeks and dependencies. 7: likelihood-by-impact risk matrix with labeled axes and risk IDs at correct coordinates, plus all mitigations. 8: funding and go/no-go decision, gate timing, every threshold, fallback HOLD if any threshold fails, and next rollout. Return ONE JSON object, no markdown, executable code or explanation.
You control the entire 8-slide, 16:9 deck. Coordinates are inches on a 13.333333 x 7.5 canvas.
Native editable PowerPoint objects are generated from this scene. Use at most 28 elements/slide.
Schema: {"theme":{"background":"FFFFFF","ink":"172B4D","accent":"007F86","font":"Arial"},
"slides":[{"background":"FFFFFF","elements":[...]}]}. Theme and slide background are optional.
Colors are six hex digits without #. Use only installed fonts Arial, Georgia or Calibri.
Each element has type plus these fields (no other element types):
text: x,y,w,h,text,size (points),color,bold (bool),align (left/center/right). Optional fields use size=18, theme ink.
rect: x,y,w,h,fill; optional line (color),radius (bool). Rectangles contain no text; add a text object.
line: x,y,x2,y2,color,width (points). Lines are native connectors.
chart: x,y,w,h,kind (bar/column/line),categories (strings),series ([{"name":"...","values":[numbers]}]),
  optional colors (one hex per series),size (axis/data text points, default 14),legend (bool),labels (bool).

table: x,y,w,h,rows (rectangular array of strings), optional size (default 14),header_fill,header_color,fill,color.

No automatic content repair, layout optimization, font shrinking or factual correction occurs.
Keep all facts accurate. Aim for a polished deck: hierarchy, alignment, contrast, restrained color,

flow: x,y,w,h,labels (2-5 short strings), optional fill,color. Evenly spaces editable boxes and connectors.
columns: x,y,w,h,items ([{"title":"...","body":"..."}]), optional fill,color. Two to four equal columns,

Return ONE JSON object, no markdown, executable code or explanation.
You control the entire 8-slide, 16:9 deck. Coordinates are inches on a 13.333333 x 7.5 canvas.
Native editable PowerPoint objects are generated from this scene. Use at most 28 elements/slide.
Schema: {"theme":{"background":"FFFFFF","ink":"172B4D","accent":"007F86","font":"Arial"},
"slides":[{"background":"FFFFFF","elements":[...]}]}. Theme and slide background are optional.
Colors are six hex digits without #. Use only installed fonts Arial, Georgia or Calibri.
Each element has type plus these fields (no other element types):
text: x,y,w,h,text,size (points),color,bold (bool),align (left/center/right). Optional fields use size=18, theme ink.
rect: x,y,w,h,fill; optional line (color),radius (bool). Rectangles contain no text; add a text object.
line: x,y,x2,y2,color,width (points). Lines are native connectors.
chart: x,y,w,h,kind (bar/column/line),categories (strings),series ([{"name":"...","values":[numbers]}]),
  optional colors (one hex per series),size (axis/data text points, default 14),legend (bool),labels (bool).
  Charts have native data/workbooks, start value axis at zero, and omit an automatic title. Add title and units with text.
table: x,y,w,h,rows (rectangular array of strings), optional size (default 14),header_fill,header_color,fill,color.
  First row is the header. All rows have equal height. Cells wrap; leave enough space.
Numbers must be finite. Put every object inside the canvas. Text wraps with a small fixed margin.
No automatic content repair, layout optimization, font shrinking or factual correction occurs.
Keep all facts accurate. Aim for a polished deck: hierarchy, alignment, contrast, restrained color,
legible labels and purposeful charts/diagrams. Vary layouts with the story. Make the decision easy to find.
Stay below 75,000 characters of JSON. Do not add author/model/tool names. No external assets or web access.

Additional optional authoring helpers expand deterministically into the SAME native primitives:
header: title, optional subtitle. Measures the installed font and inserts safe line breaks. Title uses
  24-27pt in a two-line band at (0.55,0.22,12.2,0.91); single-line subtitle uses 10-12pt at y=1.18.
  Accent rule y=1.48; put body at y>=1.7. Very long titles/subtitles fail explicitly; keep them concise.

Return ONE JSON object, no markdown, executable code or explanation.
You control the entire 8-slide, 16:9 deck. Coordinates are inches on a 13.333333 x 7.5 canvas.
Native editable PowerPoint objects are generated from this scene. Use at most 28 elements/slide.
Schema: {"theme":{"background":"FFFFFF","ink":"172B4D","accent":"007F86","font":"Arial"},
"slides":[{"background":"FFFFFF","elements":[...]}]}. Theme and slide background are optional.
Colors are six hex digits without #. Use only installed fonts Arial, Georgia or Calibri.
Each element has type plus these fields (no other element types):
text: x,y,w,h,text,size (points),color,bold (bool),align (left/center/right). Optional fields use size=18, theme ink.
rect: x,y,w,h,fill; optional line (color),radius (bool). Rectangles contain no text; add a text object.
line: x,y,x2,y2,color,width (points). Lines are native connectors.
chart: x,y,w,h,kind (bar/column/line),categories (strings),series ([{"name":"...","values":[numbers]}]),
  optional colors (one hex per series),size (axis/data text points, default 14),legend (bool),labels (bool).
  Charts have native data/workbooks, start value axis at zero, and omit an automatic title. Add title and units with text.
table: x,y,w,h,rows (rectangular array of strings), optional size (default 14),header_fill,header_color,fill,color.
  First row is the header. All rows have equal height. Cells wrap; leave enough space.
Numbers must be finite. Put every object inside the canvas. Text wraps with a small fixed margin.
No automatic content repair, layout optimization, font shrinking or factual correction occurs.
Keep all facts accurate. Aim for a polished deck: hierarchy, alignment, contrast, restrained color,
legible labels and purposeful charts/diagrams. Vary layouts with the story. Make the decision easy to find.
Stay below 75,000 characters of JSON. Do not add author/model/tool names. No external assets or web access.

Additional optional authoring helpers expand deterministically into the SAME native primitives:
header: title, optional subtitle. Measures the installed font and inserts safe line breaks. Title uses
  24-27pt in a two-line band at (0.55,0.22,12.2,0.91); single-line subtitle uses 10-12pt at y=1.18.
  Accent rule y=1.48; put body at y>=1.7. Very long titles/subtitles fail explicitly; keep them concise.
kpi: x,y,w,h,value,label, optional color. Places a large value over its smaller label, with a colored rule.
flow: x,y,w,h,labels (2-5 short strings), optional fill,color. Evenly spaces editable boxes and connectors.
columns: x,y,w,h,items ([{"title":"...","body":"..."}]), optional fill,color. Two to four equal columns,
  each with a 19pt title and 16pt body. Leave room for text. These helpers do not choose your narrative or content.
Theme colors and fonts are yours to choose. Helpers are optional; all primitive tools remain available.

text: x,y,w,h,text,size (points),color,bold (bool),align (left/center/right). Optional fields use size=18, theme ink.

Return ONE JSON object, no markdown, executable code or explanation.

text: x,y,w,h,text,size (points),color,bold (bool),align (left/center/right). Optional fields use size=18, theme ink.

Return ONE JSON object, no markdown, executable code or explanation.
You control the entire 8-slide, 16:9 deck. Coordinates are inches on a 13.333333 x 7.5 canvas.
Native editable PowerPoint objects are generated from this scene. Use at most 28 elements/slide.
Schema: {"theme":{"background":"FFFFFF","ink":"172B4D","accent":"007F86","font":"Arial"},
"slides":[{"background":"FFFFFF","elements":[...]}]}. Theme and slide background are optional.
Colors are six hex digits without #. Use only installed fonts Arial, Georgia or Calibri.
Each element has type plus these fields (no other element types):
text: x,y,w,h,text,size (points),color,bold (bool),align (left/center/right). Optional fields use size=18, theme ink.
rect: x,y,w,h,fill; optional line (color),radius (bool). Rectangles contain no text; add a text object.
line: x,y,x2,y2,color,width (points). Lines are native connectors.
chart: x,y,w,h,kind (bar/column/line),categories (strings),series ([{"name":"...","values":[numbers]}]),
  optional colors (one hex per series),size (axis/data text points, default 14),legend (bool),labels (bool).
  Charts have native data/workbooks, start value axis at zero, and omit an automatic title. Add title and units with text.
table: x,y,w,h,rows (rectangular array of strings), optional size (default 14),header_fill,header_color,fill,color.
  First row is the header. All rows have equal height. Cells wrap; leave enough space.
Numbers must be finite. Put every object inside the canvas. Text wraps with a small fixed margin.
No automatic content repair, layout optimization, font shrinking or factual correction occurs.
Keep all facts accurate. Aim for a polished deck: hierarchy, alignment, contrast, restrained color,
legible labels and purposeful charts/diagrams. Vary layouts with the story. Make the decision easy to find.
Stay below 75,000 characters of JSON. Do not add author/model/tool names. No external assets or web access.

Additional optional authoring helpers expand deterministically into the SAME native primitives:
header: title, optional subtitle. Measures the installed font and inserts safe line breaks. Title uses
  24-27pt in a two-line band at (0.55,0.22,12.2,0.91); single-line subtitle uses 10-12pt at y=1.18.

kpi: x,y,w,h,value,label, optional color. Places a large value over its smaller label, with a colored rule.
flow: x,y,w,h,labels (2-5 short strings), optional fill,color. Evenly spaces editable boxes and connectors.
columns: x,y,w,h,items ([{"title":"...","body":"..."}]), optional fill,color. Two to four equal columns,
  each with a 19pt title and 16pt body. Leave room for text. These helpers do not choose your narrative or content.
Theme colors and fonts are yours to choose. Helpers are optional; all primitive tools remain available.

- Both recommend Resilient on slides 1 and 8 with $440k, $155k, 2.8 yrs and $25k (A1/A8, B1/B8).

- A7 uses a true grid with scored risks and a risk-score table.
- A3 adds payback and net columns.

On legibility, Deck B uses slightly larger table text, but its overflow defects offset that advantage.
